titleEn: Help and support channel inside Ebda Chat
screens: AssistantPanel (support mailbox line in the empty panel)
steps: The assistant answers first; the empty assistant panel shows the support mailbox (a mailto link, the brand address) for a question it cannot answer
The guide lists what to write (store, what happened and when, an order reference, never a password / token / card / full customer number)
edgeCases: A brand with no support address shows no line (the Store brand has one)
gaps: Email only: there is no in-app support form or ticket list (Ruling WA-SUPPORT-1: one mailbox, one thread per problem)
assistantNote: Give the support address and the checklist; never promise a reply time or ask for a password, token, card or full customer number
